bodyHtml:
What This Is

Frameworks enabling AI data centers to shift batch workloads (model training, non-time-sensitive inference) to off-peak periods, reducing peak grid stress without curtailing operations..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Batch workloads (model training, non-time-sensitive inference) can be shifted to off-peak without compromising operations. Policy recommendation: demand-response frameworks with capacity market rewards. Allianz Research 2026.

What This Enables
